  SELECT memory_index_paths_fts.path, memory_index_paths_fts.source
    FROM memory_index_paths_fts

), pattern_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT path, source FROM candidates
   WHERE (path LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR path LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR path LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' OR path LIKE ? ESCAPE '\')
), scored_paths AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT path, source,
         openclaw_memory_exact_path_specificity(path) AS exact_path_specificity

  CROSS JOIN memory_index_chunks c INDEXED BY sqlite_autoindex_memory_index_chunks_1 ON c.id = (
